notes.title: Scale Enchanter Big Update
notes.content:
Hey people! We listened to your feedback and after working hard on the game here it is: [b]The Big update[/b]! We gathered feedback from the community and internally to make some corrections and the list goes:

[h2]Added scale hint panel[/h2]

If you get stuck inside the scale, you can now use the [b]hint panel[/b]! It contains info about the structure of the current scale!

It is an early feature and we would like to receive some feedback about it! So please be sure to reach us in the game's community or via our social media and tell us your opinion about it!

[h2]Use correct notation for some of the levels with unnexisting notes[/h2]

We received a lot of feedback about this. Some of our scale puzzles wasn't showing the correct structure of the 7 different notes. We improved our algorithm and now it should display the correct notes of the scale!

[h2]OpenGL Core API Support for MacOS[/h2]

We received some complaints about Scale Enchanter not working in some versions of the Apple Operating System, tracking down the problem it all boiled down to the graphics support. [b]Now[/b], it should work on most versions of MacOS due to backwards compatibility!

[h2]Fix bugs[/h2]

We did our best to find, reproduce and fix all of the bugs our community and our developers encountered along the way! Here is a short list:

[list]
[*] The misplacement of notes whenever there are close note snapping points
[*] Resize the UI on resolutions different then 1080p so the snapping points will differ
[*] We added preview notes whenever you drag a note card, so it is easier to see where you need to place the notes
[/list]

[h2]That's it![/h2]

We'd like to give our appreciation and thankfulness to all [b]community members[/b] that helped us track down the bugs and [b]gave suggestions[/b] to our game! Everything we do is for [b]you, the people that plays our games[/b] and this is very valuable!

notes.title: Minor bug fixes
notes.content:
A bug discovered by our team:

 The reset hands button was not playing any sound.

Fixed and sent to you all. Thanks for all of the community that helped us deliver our game!

notes.title: Minor Updates
notes.content:
After some feedback from the community we've created a minor version update for Scale Enchanter. What was added:

[list]
[*] Which note is being played indicator ui: Now whenever you play a scale in a level an UI will indicate which note is currently playing
[*] Reset cards button: We've added a button to reset all cards that were attached to snap points on the pentagram, making it easier to reset if you want to make it right
[*] Fixed note sound: There was a misconfiguration in one of the notes, we fixed it and now it should be all correct
[*] Fixed problem changing language on second played level and forward on: Whenever you opened a level any time other than the first and tried to change the language the button first stayed at the language selected and you had to click it again for it to be changed, that was fixed too!
[/list]

We hope you all enjoy your playthrough of Scale Enchanter, everytime there is a new problem you encounter, be sure to reach out to us here at the games community, we are keeping an eye on it, and above all, have fun!

notes.title: Launch Bug Fixes
notes.content:
With the support of the community we were able to track down and fix a couple of bugs that made the Scale Enchanter's experience incomplete. The list is as shown:
[list]
[*] Last level locked forever bug - now if you go to the E Flat Phrygian level and finish it the A Flat Phrygian scale is unlocked and playable
[*] Game freeze on level load - Whenever there was a level load with three cards to play the game was caught up with a freeze and a crash, now this does not happen anymore
[/list]

We here at XD Games Studio want to thank the community that helped us track down the bugs!
